type: Locally owned, owner-operated tree care company

estimates.typical_turnaround: Most estimates returned within 2 hours during business hours

emergency_service.instruction: For active emergencies (tree on house, car, or wires; road blocked) call (914) 391-5233 directly. For trees on or near power lines, also notify the utility (NYSEG or Con Edison) and stay clear of downed wires.

credentials.insurance: General liability, workers' compensation, and disability insurance carried and current; certificates of insurance issued on request

pricing_policy: No fixed prices are published. Tree work varies with species, size, lean, access, drop zone, proximity to structures/wires, and disposal. See https://peekskilltree.com/rates.html for cost drivers; every job gets a free on-site estimate.
